scope: Theorem 1.1 (An open set of blowup data) of the manuscript “Stable self-similar blowup for a supercritical defocusing Schrödinger equation on the torus” (preprints/Stable-Self-Similar-Blowup-for-a-Supercritical-Defocusing-Schrodinger-Equation-on-the-Torus-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 371 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 09887025fcf67354), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 1. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There exist an odd integer p ≥ 3, a finite integer k > 8, and a nonempty open set U ⊂ Hk(T12; C) with the following property. For every u0 ∈ U, the unique local solution of (1.1) extends to u ∈ C([0, T); Hk ) ∩ C1 ([0, T); Hk−2 ) for some finite T > 0, but has no continuous Hk extension through T. More precisely, there are x∗ ∈ T12 and c0 > 0 such that lim t↑T (T − t)1/(p−1) |u(t, x∗)| = c0. The power can be chosen sufficiently large, and k is then fixed after that choice.
